svg.title: FoveaWAM: real-scene role-aware geometry and Native success versus latency
svg.desc: Left: the selected full-color real photograph reconstructed with MoGe-2; future target SE(3) and sparse 3D motion are illustrative. Right: Native SR and native p95 from Table 1. FoveaWAM reports 82.1% and 15.1 ms. A single diagonal comparison points from OpenWAM-alpha to FoveaWAM; its label reports the native p95 latency ratio. Circles denote reactive policies, triangles VLAs, squares video WAMs, and the star FoveaWAM. OpenWAM-alpha (off) is outside the selected 0-200 ms range.
